subject: Cohort onboarding
body:
2026-09-16T11:25:00+02:00 — Hanna Schulz: The pack looks all right on my monitor, Nora. On a phone, your name gets split in half and the setup button is only an image.
2026-09-16T11:25:58+02:00 — Nora Stein: Kira caught that too. Lena's clarified that equipment provided means the classroom display kit, not a laptop for every student. Students don't have our internal vocabulary. We know what display kit means because we already work here.
2026-09-16T11:27:05+02:00 — Hanna Schulz: We need a plain link under the button. No amount of better spacing makes a picture clickable.
2026-09-16T11:28:23+02:00 — Nora Stein: Agreed. I'm also moving the contact block up. Thomas wants a human name before the menu of administrative options. The pack should name Finance for payment questions and Programs for timetable questions, rather than sending everything to one menu.
2026-09-16T11:29:46+02:00 — Hanna Schulz: Let me check the next export on a narrow screen before anyone prints it. The green underline will distinguish the reviewed cover. Also use the print preview. Things that fit a phone can still collide with a footer on paper.
2026-09-16T11:30:50+02:00 — Nora Stein: Please do. I'll gather the accessibility questions privately rather than let them disappear into reply-all.
